dialogues.speaker: Insigne
dialogues.text: N–Nothing! I'm just an ordinary passerby, checking my goods in a perfectly ordinary way, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Insigne
dialogues.text: Phew... I thought you were a Knight of Favonius on patrol...

dialogues.speaker: Insigne
dialogues.text: Agh— Y–You again?! When did you get here...

dialogues.speaker: Insigne
dialogues.text: You can't see me... You can't see me...

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Watch your step, my good man. What if you crushed a poor little kitten or puppy on your way down?

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Although... Scaling such heights certainly makes our interrogation easier. Honorary Knight, have you got any rope? I want to string him up in the corner and see what he has to say for himself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shall we hang him upside down?

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Oho, I was thinking the same thing. What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Insigne
dialogues.text: I'll talk! I'll tell you everything! Just get me down from here first, I'm begging you!

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: What? No resistance at all? Well... I suppose that works.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Hope you don't regret not taking the "upside-down hanging" option — the least painful, in my view — when it was still on the table, once you get back to base.
